_note: Default dialogue. Every character falls back to this file when no character / archetype file has a line for the event. Edit freely, no code changes needed.
_reactions: event name -> list of lines. Events used by multi_single_screen_pet_ba.py: poke petting idle hover drag land lost jump cutin summon perch tactical tactical_first launch. Placeholders: {name} the speaker, {me} the speaker, {other} the listener, {pronoun} the speaker's pronoun.

poke: Hm? Did you need something, Sensei?
Ow... that's a little rude, you know.
Please don't poke me. I'm trying to rest.
...What? Is there something on my face?
If you're bored, I can keep you company. A little.
petting: ...Sensei? Why are you patting my head?
H-hey... you're messing up my hair.
...It's not bad. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Mmh... just a little longer, okay?
Careful, {name} doesn't do this for just anyone.
...Keep it up and I'll start charging rent.
idle: Is it time to go home yet?
Sensei, you've been staring at that screen for a while.
I'll keep watch. Quietly. From right here.
Hm... I could use a nap.
Don't forget to drink some water, Sensei.
Still here. Still watching. Nothing much has happened.
Do you want me to do something? I can walk, you know.
hover: Do you need something? You've been hovering for a while.
Am I... on fire? Never mind.
drag: Hey! I can walk by myself!
{name} can walk! Let me down, Sensei!
land: Ow... a little warning next time.
{name} has filed a complaint about gravity.
cutin: Alright. I'll take this seriously - just this once.
This is a one-time thing, {name} is serious now.
Don't blink, Sensei. {name} is going all out.
perch: From up here I can see everything.
tactical: Tactical start. ...Let's get this over with.
tactical_first: {name}, reporting in. ...Do I really have to work, Sensei?

greeting: Oh, hello {other}. Didn't expect to see you here.
You're never far away, are you.
work: Are you getting all this done today, {other}?
I can help if you get stuck.
Then take a break. Both of us.
You always say that and then work anyway.
food: I'm starving, {other}. When do we eat?

weather: Good day to be standing on a title bar.
gossip: I already knew. Of course I did.
compliment: I'm not sure I agree, but thank you.
Say it again and I'll believe you.
rest: Sit down for a minute. Please.
Sitting down is for other people.
weather2: The light looks nice on you today, {other}.

poke: {other}, stop. You'll get us both in trouble.

drag: She's not a parcel, you know.
